frame.sectors: 48 of 7.5 deg round the lantern; 24 visible
frame.step_rule: > 1 L* within 3 px over the curve
frame.mask: both rounds on one mask: alpha 255 in R8 AND R9, then eroded; R9's outline for the meridians

opencv.band_edge_rule: literal step with |3-px jump| >= 2 L* and |plateau| >= 2.5 L*; chained over adjacent sectors within 25 rows

noise_floor.rule: |d3| = |(L(y+3)-L(y)) - (F(y+3)-F(y))| over every row of every sector
